clues.text: Noah was 600 years old when this came upon the earth.
Two years after this, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.
In Noah's day, its waters covered even the highest mountaintops to a depth of fifteen cubits.
In Jesus' story of the wise builder, this came against the house on the rock but could not shake it.
The man who built the ark lived 350 more years after this.
Jesus said that in the days before this, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage.
Peter wrote that God brought this on the ungodly ancient world but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among eight.
